svg.title: The same profile at three brake positions, with the airflow computed
svg.desc: Streamlines, the pressure on the surface and the point where the lift acts, computed for today's profile hands up, with a little brake and with a lot of brake: a 2D inviscid panel method at an illustrative 6 degrees. As the brake comes on, the lift grows and its centre moves back along the chord. A physics illustration, not a measurement.
svg.text: lift acts at 37% of the chord
lift acts at 39% of the chord
lift acts at 41% of the chord
2D inviscid panel method · illustrative 6° · no separation, so heavy-brake suction is overstated
